settings.heading: Make the most of your laptop

settings.question: Are refurbished laptops worth it?
settings.answer: Yes. A refurbished MacBook or Windows laptop gives you the same performance as new for a lot less, backed by a 1-year warranty.

settings.question: Is the battery checked?
settings.answer: Yes. Every battery is tested, and batteries below our health threshold are replaced before sale.

settings.question: What does refurbished mean?
settings.answer: A refurbished device has had a previous owner, then gone through our technicians: tested, repaired where needed, wiped, cleaned and graded. It works like new and comes with a 1-year warranty.

settings.question: What's the difference between refurbished and used?
settings.answer: Used means sold as-is. Refurbished means professionally checked, fixed and backed by a warranty and free 30-day returns.

settings.question: What warranty and returns do I get?
settings.answer: Every device comes with a 1-year warranty and free 30-day returns, for any reason.

settings.question: What about my old device?
settings.answer: Trade it in. Get an instant quote on our trade-in page and put the value toward your next device.

settings.heading: Why buy a refurbished laptop from SmartSource?
settings.body: A refurbished laptop does everything a new one does, for a lot less money. Every laptop is inspected, tested and graded by our technicians, wiped and restored to factory settings. Every one comes with a 1-year warranty and free 30-day returns.

settings.heading: What laptops can you find?
settings.body:
• MacBook Air and MacBook Pro: Apple silicon performance, all-day battery
  • Windows laptops: for work, school and everything between
  • Chromebooks: simple, fast and affordable
  • Gaming laptops: serious power for less

settings.heading: Understanding grades
settings.body: Grades only describe how a laptop looks, from Premium (like new) to Fair (visible wear). Every grade is fully functional and covered by the same warranty.
